# Button Counter (Knopenteller; previously Buttons / Knopen tellen; also Counting Buttons)

> A tool for your financial future. Enter your age, savings and monthly budget and see the chance your money lasts, based on 4,000 simulations. For 11 countries, no account.

Button Counter is a free, single-page retirement calculator at https://countingbuttons.com. It runs entirely in the browser, needs no account and stores what you enter only on your own device. It is a general calculation tool and does not give financial advice.

## Pages

- [How long will your savings last? See your financial future | Button Counter (English)](https://countingbuttons.com/): A tool for your financial future. Enter your age, savings and monthly budget and see the chance your money lasts, based on 4,000 simulations. For 11 countries, no account.
- [Hoe lang gaat je spaargeld mee? Zie je financiële toekomst | Knopenteller (Nederlands)](https://countingbuttons.com/nl/): Rekentool voor je financiële toekomst en eerder stoppen met werken. Vul je leeftijd, spaargeld en maandbudget in en zie de kans dat je geld genoeg is, op basis van 4.000 simulaties.
- [Wie lange reicht Ihr Erspartes? Ihre finanzielle Zukunft im Blick | Button Counter (Deutsch)](https://countingbuttons.com/de/): Rechner für Ihre finanzielle Zukunft. Alter, Erspartes und Monatsbudget eingeben und sehen, mit welcher Wahrscheinlichkeit Ihr Geld reicht. Auf Basis von 4.000 Simulationen.
- [Combien de temps durera votre épargne ? Votre avenir financier en vue | Button Counter (Français)](https://countingbuttons.com/fr/): Simulateur pour votre avenir financier. Indiquez votre âge, votre épargne et votre budget mensuel et voyez la probabilité que votre argent suffise, sur la base de 4 000 simulations.
- [¿Cuánto durarán tus ahorros? Mira tu futuro financiero | Button Counter (Español)](https://countingbuttons.com/es/): Calculadora para tu futuro financiero. Introduce tu edad, tus ahorros y tu presupuesto mensual y mira la probabilidad de que tu dinero alcance, con 4.000 simulaciones.

## Question pages

- [Is mijn geld genoeg als ik stop met werken?](https://countingbuttons.com/nl/is-mijn-geld-genoeg/): Bereken de kans dat je spaargeld genoeg is tot je eindleeftijd, met AOW, pensioen, box 3 en inflatie. Zonder account, je gegevens blijven op je eigen apparaat.
- [Will my money last when I stop working?](https://countingbuttons.com/will-my-money-last/): Calculate the chance that your savings last until your end age, with state pension, pension, tax and inflation. No account; your data stays on your own device.
- [Hoeveel kan ik per maand uitgeven als ik stop met werken?](https://countingbuttons.com/nl/hoeveel-kan-ik-per-maand-uitgeven/): Zie welk maandbudget je kunt aanhouden met je spaargeld, AOW en pensioen, en hoe groot de kans is dat het genoeg is. Zonder account.
- [How much can I spend each month when I stop working?](https://countingbuttons.com/how-much-can-i-spend-in-retirement/): See which monthly budget your savings and pensions can support, and the chance that it is enough. No account needed.
- [Kan ik eerder stoppen met werken?](https://countingbuttons.com/nl/eerder-stoppen-met-werken/): Reken uit wat eerder stoppen of minder werken doet met je spaargeld en pensioen. Met AOW, pensioen en box 3, zonder account.
- [Can I stop working earlier?](https://countingbuttons.com/retire-early/): Calculate what stopping earlier or working less does to your savings and pensions, with the rules of your country. No account needed.
- [Wat is mijn geld waard in een ander land?](https://countingbuttons.com/nl/met-pensioen-naar-het-buitenland/): Vergelijk de koopkracht van je maandbudget in 31 Europese landen en reken je plan door met de regels van tien landen. Zonder account.
- [What is my money worth in another country?](https://countingbuttons.com/retire-abroad/): Compare the purchasing power of your monthly budget in 31 European countries and test your plan with the rules of ten countries. No account needed.

## Questions and answers

### What is Button Counter?

Button Counter gives you a view of your financial future: how long your savings will last and what changes when you adjust something. You enter your age, your savings and what you want to spend each month. Button Counter then shows the chance that your money lasts until your end age, based on 4,000 simulations of good and bad market years.

### Why Button Counter instead of a simple calculator?

A simple calculator answers one sum, such as how long an amount lasts or how much tax you pay on savings. Button Counter puts everything in one plan: your savings, your pension and state pension, work per period, one or two people and the rules of your country. Instead of one number you see the chance that your money is enough, based on 4,000 simulations. Every number shows whether it comes from a source, is an assumption or was entered by you.

### How much savings do I need to stop working?

That depends on your monthly budget, your age and the pension you will receive. Button Counter calculates the amount you need for a 90% chance that your money is enough. As a rough rule of thumb, people often need 25 to 30 times the yearly spending that their pensions do not cover.

### How is the chance of success calculated?

Button Counter runs 4,000 simulations in which returns go up and down each year. It does this for three portfolios (defensive, balanced and aggressive), after costs, tax and inflation, so every amount is in today’s money. The chance of success is the share of simulations in which your money lasts until your end age. Two crash scenarios, one like 2008 and one like 2022, are shown separately.

### Which countries does Button Counter support?

Button Counter has its own rules for the Netherlands, Belgium, Germany, France, Spain, Italy, Portugal, Ireland, the United Kingdom and the United States, plus a general setting for other countries. Each country has its own state pension, pension age and tax on investments. Button Counter also compares what your budget is worth in 31 European countries, based on Eurostat price levels.

### Is Button Counter free, and what happens to my data?

At the moment Button Counter is free to use, has no advertising and needs no account. What you enter stays in your own browser on your own device and is not sent to Button Counter. Visits and the use of features are counted anonymously, without cookies.

### Is this financial advice?

No. Button Counter is a general calculation tool that gives estimates based on simplified rules and assumptions. It does not give advice about your personal situation. Check official sources and consult an independent, licensed adviser before you make important financial decisions.

## Facts

- Method: Monte Carlo simulation, 4,000 runs, three portfolios (defensive, balanced, aggressive), after costs, tax and inflation; all amounts in today's money.
- Headline result: the chance that savings last until the end age, and the capital needed for a 90% chance.
- Countries with their own rules: Netherlands, Belgium, Germany, France, Spain, Italy, Portugal, Ireland, United Kingdom, United States; plus a general setting.
- Purchasing power comparison: 31 European countries, Eurostat price levels.
- Languages: English, Dutch, German, French, Spanish.
- Price: free. No advertising. No account.
